sources.locator: Full rendered curriculum and nine exact complete course popups.

sources.title: Biology: Ecology and Evolution Immersion — 2026–2027 four additional biology course cards
sources.locator: Full route rules previously reviewed; exact BIOL-211/212/240/575 popups reviewed here. Other non-BIOL card content remains unread.

scope: 13 actual BIOL course descriptions; no recursive prerequisite expansion and no claim that the ecology route non-BIOL content is complete.
credit_observation: Five BIOL cards carry four credits, seven carry three, and the molecular laboratory carries one. Preserve individual amounts despite the cellular table’s six-hour two-elective subtotal and ten-hour total. The selection can exceed that displayed total; do not replace individual four-credit facts with three.

BIOL-206.name: Molecular Biology
BIOL-206.description: Structure and function of DNA, RNA and proteins; genetic information flow, DNA maintenance/repair and molecular interactions.
BIOL-206.prerequisites: Prerequisite:(BIOL-101,BIOL-102,BIOL-103&BIOL-104) or (BIOL-121&BIOL-122) or (BIOL-123,BIOL-124,BIOL-125&BIOL-126) with a grade of C- or higher. Co-requisite:(CHMG-141 & CHMG-145) or (CHEM-151 & CHEM-155) or CHMG-131 or (CHEM-171 & CHEM-175).

category_review.locator: BIOL-206 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Molecular mechanisms and biological structure/function are the substantive domain, not AI methods.

BIOL-216.name: Molecular Biology Laboratory
BIOL-216.description: Laboratory practice in recombinant DNA and detecting or tracking DNA, RNA and proteins.
BIOL-216.prerequisites: Prerequisite:(BIOL-101&BIOL-102&BIOL-103&BIOL-104)or(BIOL-121&BIOL-122)or(BIOL-123&BIOL-124&BIOL-125&BIOL-126) w/ grade of C- or higher. Co-requisite:BIOL-206&((CHMG-141&CHMG-145)or(CHEM-151&CHEM-155)orCHMG-131 or (CHEM-171 & CHEM-175)).

category_review.locator: BIOL-216 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The course practices molecular-biological laboratory techniques.

BIOL-265.name: Evolutionary Biology
BIOL-265.description: Evidence and mechanisms of biological evolution, molecular change, selection, genetic variation, phylogeny, biogeography and human variation.
BIOL-265.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-101 and BIOL-102 and BIOL-103 and BIOL-104) or (BIOL-121 and BIOL-122) or (BIOL-123 and BIOL-124 and BIOL-125 and BIOL-126) or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-265 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Evolutionary biology and biological evidence are the primary subject; its historical framing does not make it a history course.

BIOL-302.name: Cell Biology
BIOL-302.description: Cell structure/function, signaling, genetic information, energy transformation, biomolecules and organization into tissues and organs.
BIOL-302.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-206 and BIOL-216) or BIOL-201 or BIOL-202 or BIOG-240 or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-302 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The description centers on cellular biological processes and organization.

BIOL-311.name: Introduction to Microbiology
BIOL-311.description: Microbial structure, metabolism, communities, infectious disease and immunology, with bacteriology techniques and a student-designed laboratory investigation.
BIOL-311.prerequisites: Prerequisites: BIOL-206 and BIOL-216 or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-311 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Microbiological knowledge and laboratory investigation dominate; associated ethical/political discussion is contextual.

BIOL-321.name: Genetics
BIOL-321.description: Inheritance and genes/chromosomes at molecular, cellular, organismal and population levels.
BIOL-321.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-206 and BIOL-216) or BIOL-201 or BIOL-202 or BIOG-240 or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-321 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The precise description studies biological inheritance across levels of organization.

BIOL-322.name: Developmental Biology
BIOL-322.description: Growth, differentiation and organismal development, connected with disease, ecology and evolution.
BIOL-322.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-206 and BIOL-216) or BIOL-201 or BIOL-202 or BIOG-240 or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-322 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Organismal development and its biological relationships are the central subject.

BIOL-365.name: Introduction to Population Genetics
BIOL-365.description: Gene structure and inheritance, variation, selection, drift, population subdivision, molecular evolution and quantitative-trait genetics.

category_review.locator: BIOL-365 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The full description centers on biological genetic processes and population mechanisms; named genetic principles do not establish a mathematics-methods course.

BIOL-427.name: Microbial and Viral Genetics
BIOL-427.description: Genome integrity, gene regulation and genetic acquisition in bacteria/viruses, with biotechnology relevance and laboratory work on molecular mechanisms.
BIOL-427.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-206 and BIOL-216) or BIOL-201 or BIOL-202 or BIOG-240 or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-427 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Microbial genetics and experimental biological mechanisms dominate the description.

BIOL-211.name: Invertebrate Zoology
BIOL-211.description: Invertebrate biology emphasizing evolutionary relationships and functional anatomy.
BIOL-211.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-101 and BIOL-102 and BIOL-103 and BIOL-104) or (BIOL-121 and BIOL-122) or (BIOL-123 and BIOL-124 and BIOL-125 and BIOL-126) or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-211 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The exact description is zoological domain knowledge.

BIOL-212.name: Vertebrate Zoology
BIOL-212.description: Ecological, behavioral, anatomical and physiological characteristics of vertebrates in evolutionary context.
BIOL-212.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-101 and BIOL-102 and BIOL-103 and BIOL-104) or (BIOL-121 and BIOL-122) or (BIOL-123 and BIOL-124 and BIOL-125 and BIOL-126) or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-212 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: The course synthesizes vertebrate biological characteristics.

BIOL-240.name: General Ecology
BIOL-240.description: Population, community and ecosystem ecology, including energy flow, trophic relationships, dynamics and biogeography.
BIOL-240.prerequisites: Prerequisites: (BIOL-101 and BIOL-102 and BIOL-103 and BIOL-104) or (BIOL-121 and BIOL-122) or (BIOL-123 and BIOL-124 and BIOL-125 and BIOL-126) or equivalent courses.

category_review.locator: BIOL-240 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Ecological processes and organism-environment relationships are the subject.

BIOL-575.name: Conservation Biology
BIOL-575.description: Ecological principles applied to conservation, human effects on species diversity and management/restoration of agricultural, forest, coastal and wetland ecosystems.

category_review.locator: BIOL-575 complete rendered card under the 2026–2027 public immersion curriculum
category_review.rationale: Conservation ecology and ecosystem management are substantive biological applications; human impact is the ecological problem context.
